title: invocation-context
description: Where a command runs, as `swissknifeman project context --json` prints it: the project (write, config and state boundary) and the folder the command was called from, and how the project was found.

project_root.description: Canonical absolute project root; null when no project was found.

invocation_cwd.description: Absolute folder the command was called from.

resolution.description: How the project was found: the project-local launcher, --project, SKM_PROJECT_ROOT, the nearest .git, the nearest .swissknifeman, or not at all.

marker.description: Marker entry that matched when the project was searched for.

launcher.description: The launcher that bound the project; null without one.

verified.description: Whether the managed launcher matches its lock and the hub template.

config.description: Project configuration file (it may not exist yet).
